newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco power sales up, but below H1 target.
newsitem.headline: Meralco power sales up, but below H1 target.

text.p: The Manila Electric Co said on Tuesday electricity sales rose six percent in the first half of the year but were a little below target.
"Kilowatt sales were up by six percent in the first half. We were slightly lower than expected," Meralco president Manuel Lopez told reporters.
"We were looking at between 7-8 percent," Lopez said, adding that first quarter sales were slow.
The second quarter was higher but he did not give further details.
Systems losses, such as pilfering, fell to 12.3 percent from 12.8 percent a year earlier.
Lopez added that the company would announce its first half results on Friday, July 25.
